method: Independent AI semantic review of each supplied quote against full request, frozen policy and frozen minimum facts; support and reference coverage assessed separately. No map, labels beyond supplied references, prompts, run records or other sources consulted. All fact indices partitioned. Initial grades saved before this process seal.
limitations: AI semantic judgment, not human adjudication or ground truth; no claim of training-data exclusion. Repeated request text was visible in blinded input; no policy arm was supplied or inferred.
